title: Suffering and God's Purpose
definition: Suffering and God's purpose teaches that pain and hardship are not meaningless in God's sovereign hands.
summary: God does not waste suffering. Though believers may not understand every reason, Scripture shows that God can use suffering to refine, comfort, humble, strengthen, and display His grace.
christFocus: Christ suffered for redemption and now comforts His people in their suffering.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God does not waste suffering. Though believers may not understand every reason, Scripture shows that God can use suffering to refine, comfort, humble, strengthen, and display His grace.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
